title: [GMCP 203.027.M] Mastery: Enterprise and machine-to-machine authorization extensions
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-027-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: GMCP implements and tests official enterprise-managed authorization and OAuth client-credentials extension profiles without conflating user and workload identity. Policy chooses flows explicitly, administrators can constrain issuers and clients, managed settings are tamper-evident, credentials are audience-bound and rotated, and unsupported or draft profiles are labeled and safely declined. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
